causes.cycle: claim on or downstream of a dependency cycle (least vs greatest fixpoint)
causes.unentitled_support: claim downstream of a committed-but-not-entitled claim (support through commitment vs through eligibility)
causes.conflict_scope: claim in, or downstream of, an incompatibility whose other member is committed but not finally entitled (which items conflicts are resolved among, and whether a defeat is undone when the defeating claim later loses entitlement)
causes.support: fixpoint choice: every differing claim is on or downstream of a dependency cycle (least vs greatest fixpoint of eligibility)
causes.support_single: two-status structure: every differing claim is downstream of a committed-but-not-entitled claim (support flows through commitment in two-status scorekeeping, only through eligibility in the single-status graph), or on/downstream of a cycle
causes.scorekeeping_no_entitlement: entitlement tracking: every differing claim is a committed-but-not-entitled claim or downstream of one

dependency_tracing.note: by construction for any representation with dependency records

error_detection.note: clean = false-alarm rate. Detection by recompiling needs dependency records (any representation that has them), not a particular vocabulary

enabling_matrix.note: gated collapse is by construction for conditions measured by a gate; the ungated columns are the empirical test of whether reasoning adds operational value in the degraded world
